Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som städare i Göteborg med omnejd. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi?
· En tjänst på 75 %
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år
· Gratis mobilabonnemang
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester
Hos oss får du rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas. Har du viljan, så ger vi dig verktygen för att briljera!
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:
· Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och i team
· Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och engagerad
· Vill utvecklas och lära dig mer
· Talar svenska eller engelska
· Kan arbeta flexibla arbetstider (måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–17.00)
· Är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder
Meriterande:
· B-körkort (egen bil är ett plus)
· Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN GOTHENBURG – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Gothenburg and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Meritorious:
· B driver’s license (own car is a plus)
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

About the Role
We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain and improve the data infrastructure and backend services supporting our RE:Flex platform.
The role involves working with real-time IoT data, cloud infrastructure, databases and data pipelines to ensure reliable data collection, processing, storage and delivery.
You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers and other teams across the business, operations and finance. Alongside hands-on development, you will contribute to technical improvements, code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Data Engineering and Pipelines
Develop and maintain Python-based services for collecting and processing data from connected energy devices, including battery systems and meters.
Build and improve real-time and batch data pipelines using MQTT, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and other messaging technologies.
Integrate data from external APIs, energy market platforms and other relevant data sources.
Implement data validation, error handling, retry mechanisms and safe backfilling to improve data quality and reliability.
Develop and maintain data processing workflows, including aggregation and transformation of time-series data.

Backend Development and Cloud Infrastructure
Develop and maintain backend APIs and services for accessing real-time and historical platform data.
Work with databases and storage solutions such as BigQuery, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, depending on application requirements.
Develop, deploy and maintain containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Contribute to cloud infrastructure improvements, primarily within Google Cloud Platform.
Support integrations between data services, backend applications and other platform components.

Data Quality, Monitoring and Reliability
Monitor data pipelines, database performance and service reliability using tools such as Grafana and cloud monitoring services.
Investigate data inconsistencies, missing records, processing failures and other production issues.
Improve data processing performance, scalability and operational stability.
Implement appropriate data quality checks, logging, monitoring and alerting.
Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and implementation of technical fixes.

Energy Market and Business Data
Support data processing and integration for energy market operations, including market prices, schedules, measurements and settlement information.
Develop and maintain data workflows used for operational reporting, revenue calculations and customer invoicing.
Work with market operations, finance and other business teams to understand data requirements and resolve discrepancies.
Help ensure data consistency and traceability across relevant systems and integrations.

Technical Collaboration and Documentation
Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions and code reviews.
Coordinate with backend, DevOps, machine learning and other engineering teams on data-related implementations.
Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with other engineers.
Maintain technical documentation, data flow descriptions and operational procedures.
Contribute to continuous improvements in development practices, deployment processes and platform reliability.

Required Qualifications
Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development or a related software engineering role.
Strong programming skills in Python and good knowledge of SQL.
Experience developing data pipelines, backend services and REST APIs.
Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud-based data processing.
Familiarity with messaging systems, streaming data or asynchronous processing.
Practical experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure.
Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing and debugging.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.
Professional working proficiency in English.

Meriting Experience
Google Cloud Platform, particularly Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
MQTT, IoT telemetry or real-time data processing.
TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other time-series and NoSQL databases.
Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Dagster, Airflow or similar data orchestration tools.
Monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
Experience with data reconciliation, reporting or invoicing integrations.
Knowledge of battery energy storage systems, energy flexibility services or Nordic electricity markets.
Experience supporting technical onboarding, documentation or cross-team coordination.

What We Offer
The opportunity to contribute to Sweden's energy transition through real-world energy technology solutions.
Hands-on experience working with real-time data, cloud infrastructure and distributed energy systems.
A collaborative engineering environment with opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and platform improvements.
The opportunity to work across data engineering, backend development and energy market applications.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Professional Front-end Developer – React & TypeScript
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week in the office
Domain: Digital Services & Customer-Facing Applications
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
Are you a passionate Front-end Developer with strong expertise in React and TypeScript? Do you enjoy building modern, responsive, and accessible web applications while taking ownership of features from initial requirements through production?
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a Professional Front-end Developer to join a digital product development team focused on delivering high-quality customer-facing digital services.
About the Role
You will develop and maintain customer-facing features for a modern digital portal, taking end-to-end ownership of front-end solutions — from requirements clarification and UX collaboration to implementation, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Working closely with Product Owners, UX designers, backend developers, and other engineering colleagues, you will contribute to front-end architecture, reusable components, application performance, and overall user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web applications using React and TypeScript.
Own front-end features throughout the complete development lifecycle, from requirements to production.
Build reusable, secure, maintainable, and well-tested UI components.
Integrate front-end applications with REST and GraphQL APIs.
Contribute to front-end architecture, state management, and technical design decisions.
Develop and maintain unit, component, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Improve application performance, accessibility, browser compatibility, observability, and reliability.
Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve applications in production.
Collaborate with Product Owners, UX designers, backend developers, and engineering teams.
Participate in constructive code reviews and share technical knowledge with colleagues.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, validating generated outputs for quality, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications
Demonstrated experience independently delivering front-end features in production environments.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
Experience with modern front-end architecture, reusable component design, and state management.
Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs and managing asynchronous application flows.
Practical knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, package management, and front-end build tools.
Experience with automated testing using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Understanding of web accessibility, responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimisation, and front-end security.
Ability to interpret Figma designs and collaborate effectively with UX designers.
Experience working in Agile product teams using Scrum or Kanban.
Strong ownership, analytical problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
Experience with design systems and component libraries.
Knowledge of Node.js, server-side rendering, or micro-frontend architecture.
Experience with WebSockets, event-driven user interfaces, or real-time applications.
Experience with AWS, observability tools, or cloud-hosted web applications.
Knowledge of clean architecture, reusable design principles, and front-end performance optimisation.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Kiro, MCP servers, or AI agents.
Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Interaction Design, or equivalent practical experience.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who:
Takes ownership and delivers features independently.
Has a strong user-focused mindset and an eye for detail.
Enjoys solving technical challenges and continuously improving applications.
Works effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
Shares knowledge and contributes to a collaborative engineering culture.
Is curious about modern front-end technologies and responsible AI-assisted development.

Working Arrangement
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
Work Model: Hybrid.
Office Presence: Minimum 3 days per week.
Team Environment: Collaborative digital product development with a strong focus on customer value and engineering excellence.

How to Apply
Are you ready to build modern digital experiences and take ownership of customer-facing applications from concept to production?
Submit your updated CV through the Hykmann careers portal: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Please highlight the following in your application:
Your professional experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Examples of front-end features you have independently delivered to production.
Experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and front-end architecture.
Automated testing experience and CI/CD knowledge.
Experience with accessibility, performance optimisation, and production monitoring.
Relevant experience with AI-assisted development tools, if applicable.

jobs.occupation: EY-Parthenon Senior Consultant | Strategy & Execution - Deal Technology
jobs.description:
The opportunity
 
At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we have reimagined strategic consulting for a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.
 
EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, working on Deal Technology where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will grow with it, from building your expertise to contributing to our offering, while supporting clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions.
 
 
Your key responsibilities
 
As a Senior Consultant, you will own defined workstreams within complex, time-critical engagements. Working with engagement managers, investors and M&A teams, you will turn technology, data and AI questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations that connect to transaction logic and business value creation.
 
Conducting analyses and leading workstreams in IT and technology due diligence, and presenting decision-relevant insights to project leaders and clients.
Supporting carve-out, separation and integration programmes, including TSA design, IT disentanglement and Day 1 readiness.
Contributing to AI-enabled operating model transformation and technology-led growth initiatives across AI, data, cloud, digital platforms, applications and ERP.
Delivering your workstreams with quality and on time, while supporting junior colleagues and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing team.

 
 
Skills and attributes for success
 
A relevant master's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a comparable field.
Relevant experience from strategy or management consulting, transaction advisory, M&A or complex technology-enabled change, including working in client teams and delivering defined workstreams.
Exposure to digital, data and AI or core IT, ERP and infrastructure, with an interest in developing across both areas and connecting technology choices to business outcomes.
A structured, hands-on approach, strong analytical and communication skills, and fluency in English.

 
 
Ideally, you will also have
 
Experience from technology or IT in transactions, separations or integrations, or knowledge of ERP, cloud, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data or AI in a deal context.
Early experience of guiding junior colleagues or contributing to proposals and client opportunities.
Experience working with private equity investors or corporate M&A functions in the Nordics, plus a Nordic language.

 
 
What we offer you
 
Complex, high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in transaction environments.
A collaborative, inclusive and entrepreneurial team culture with strong opportunities to learn and grow.
Modern offices in central Stockholm and Gothenburg, with flexible ways of working.

 
Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.
 
 
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 
Application deadline: 22nd of November 2026. For questions about the recruitment process, contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
 
At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you need assistance or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

1. Job Purpose
The Payroll Administrator is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll administration for the company's employees in accordance with Swedish labour legislation, applicable collective bargaining agreements (Collective Agreements), company policies, and tax regulations.
The role involves managing the complete monthly payroll process, maintaining employee payroll records, handling salary-related inquiries, and coordinating with HR, Finance, external payroll providers, and relevant authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Payroll Administration
Prepare, process, and verify monthly payroll for employees.
Ensure salaries are calculated accurately and paid on the agreed payment dates.
Process fixed salaries, hourly wages, overtime, additional allowances, bonuses, and other salary components.

Verify working hours, timesheets, attendance records, and approved overtime.
Handle salary corrections, retroactive payments, deductions, and final salary settlements.

Ensure payroll calculations comply with applicable Swedish Collective Agreements, including Unionen and Installatörsföretagen agreements, as applicable.

Support HR in payroll-related union inquiries and collective agreement compliance matters.

C. Employee Records and Documentation

Register new employees and update employment-related payroll information.
Process changes in salary, bank details, tax information, and employment status.

Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with GDPR and data protection requirements.

D. Coordination and Reporting

Communicate with external payroll consultants, accounting firms, and relevant authorities when required.
Prepare payroll reports, salary summaries, and monthly payroll reconciliations.
Assist with budgeting, payroll cost analysis, and financial reporting.
Identify payroll discrepancies and recommend improvements to payroll procedures.

Previous experience in payroll administration in Sweden.
Good knowledge of Swedish payroll regulations and employment legislation.
Understanding of Swedish Collective Agreements, particularly Unionen and Installatörsföretagen.
Knowledge of Swedish tax regulations and Skatteverket reporting requirements.
Experience with payroll systems and HR administration tools.
Good numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
High attention to detail and ability to meet strict payroll deadlines.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

4. Language Requirements
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Good command of Swedish is highly desirable.
Turkish language skills are considered an advantage.

5. Personal Competencies
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
Excellent planning and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to identifying and resolving payroll discrepancies.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Payroll Administrator's performance will be evaluated based on:
Accuracy of monthly payroll processing.
Timely salary payments.
Compliance with Swedish legislation and collective agreements.

Number of payroll discrepancies and correction requests.

Design, develop and improve mechanical solutions using the Creo 3D CAD system and the Windchill PDM system
Take an active part in development projects, with a focus on simplicity, scalability, repeatability and quality, to create the best possible production setup for Axis products
Work from concept to verified product in cross-functional projects
The role may include travel, mainly to our contract manufacturers around the world, for approximately 15 days a year.

You are structured and driven, with a natural commitment to seeing your deliverables through to completion. You enjoy working cross-functionally, you have an open mindset, and you help build a creative environment around you.

A bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering
At least 2 years' relevant experience of product development
Experience of 3D CAD, ideally Creo
Experience of 3D printing and of designing parts specifically for 3D printing
Very good communication skills in English
Communication skills in Swedish

 
Bonus points if you have any combination of:
Design experience from mechatronics and automation
Experience of designing and producing moving mechanics, and of designing aluminum parts for CNC machining
International production experience, or experience of developing production equipment

Operational Excellence: Drive continuous gains in cost efficiency, last-mile quality, and scalability across international markets.

Data & KPIs: Define, monitor, and iterate on routing KPIs, dashboards, and operational performance insights.

Consumer Experience: Set the standard for driver interactions with end consumers.

Your Future Team

Relevant academic degree.

Proven track record of deconstructing complex operational or optimization problems into actionable product initiatives.

Strong business acumen with experience building business cases and prioritizing by financial and operational impact.

Strong capability working with data, KPIs, and performance dashboards.

Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse functions and organizational levels.

Fluency in English (Swedish is optional).

More About You
Action-Oriented in Ambiguity: You don’t wait for perfect data; you formulate hypotheses, build tests, and iterate quickly.

Grounded in Reality: You enjoy getting out into the field—visiting hubs and terminals, riding along with drivers, and validating insights in the real world rather than solely behind dashboards.

Pragmatic & Impact-Driven: While versed in modern product frameworks, you are equally comfortable championing direct operational adjustments when that delivers the highest business value.

What We Offer

Rapid iteration cycles and the opportunity to see your work deployed at international scale.

Ready for an active job in Stockholm? Join MoveByBike!
Looking for a job where you can stay active, work independently and spend your days moving around Stockholm rather than sitting behind a desk?
MoveByBike is expanding our delivery operations and is looking for new team members to work as Cargo Bike Drivers, E-Bike Drivers and Bike Couriers.
We use modern electric cargo bikes (el-lastcyklar) to transport parcels, groceries, batteries and other goods throughout Stockholm. As part of our delivery team, you will help keep the city moving while contributing to a more sustainable transport system.
We are particularly interested in candidates who want to work full-time or take on several shifts each week. Part-time opportunities are also available.
What does a typical working day look like?
Your job is to collect, transport and deliver goods using one of our electric cargo bikes.
You will:

Ride an electric cargo bike through Stockholm.

Deliver parcels, food products and other goods to customers.

Follow planned delivery routes and use digital navigation tools.

Handle deliveries carefully and professionally.

Work with our dispatch team to complete your daily assignments.

Follow traffic regulations and safety procedures.

This is an active, physically demanding job that involves working outdoors in different weather conditions, including during the Swedish winter.
If you enjoy cycling, physical activity and taking responsibility for your work, this could be a great fit.
Who are we looking for?
You don't need previous experience as a delivery driver or bike courier. What matters most is your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn.
To join our team, you must:

Be at least 18 years old.

Speak and understand Swedish or English.

Be comfortable cycling in urban traffic.

Be physically capable of handling an active delivery job.

Be reliable, punctual and able to follow work schedules.

Be prepared to work outdoors throughout the year.

No driver's license is required.
Previous experience in food delivery, parcel distribution, courier services or similar logistics work is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Flexible shifts – full-time and part-time
We offer both full-time and part-time employment opportunities.
Our delivery operations run between 08:00 and 22:00, including evenings and weekends.
We are especially interested in people who can work regularly and take on multiple shifts each week.

Full-time availability is highly valued.

Part-time employees must be available for at least 2 shifts per week (approximately 10 hours).

Evening and weekend shifts are available.

Students and people looking for additional work are welcome to apply.

Let us know your availability when submitting your application.
Pay, employment and equipment
Experienced riders earn approximately 155 SEK per hour on average, including base salary, performance bonuses and evening/weekend supplements. Holiday pay is added on top.
Actual earnings depend on the applicable supplements and performance bonuses.
All our riders receive an employment contract.
You will also receive the equipment needed to perform your work:

Electric cargo bike / e-bike.

Work phone for communication and navigation.

Professional work clothing.

How to join MoveByBike
We aim to make our recruitment process straightforward and efficient.

Submit your application online and upload your CV.

Meet our recruitment team for an interview if your application meets our requirements.

Show your cycling skills during a practical riding test with our operations team.

Get started with your employment contract, introduction and onboarding training if selected.

We are actively recruiting for our Stockholm operations and encourage candidates who are available to start soon to apply.
Why choose MoveByBike?
At MoveByBike, you become part of a team working to transform how goods are delivered in cities.
You'll enjoy an active working environment, supportive colleagues, opportunities for regular work and the chance to contribute to cleaner urban logistics.
Whether you are an experienced bicycle courier or looking for your first delivery job, we would like to hear from you.
Apply now – become an E-Bike Driver or Cargo Bike Courier with MoveByBike in Stockholm!
MoveByBike Recruitment Team
